sentences.text: Neymar da Silva Santos Júnior -LRB- -LSB- nejˈmaʁ dɐ ˈsiwvɐ ˈsɐ̃tus ˈʒũɲoʁ -RSB- ; born 5 February 1992 -RRB- , commonly known as Neymar or Neymar Jr. , is a Brazilian professional footballer who plays as a forward for Spanish club FC Barcelona and the Brazil national team .	Barcelona	FC Barcelona	Santos	Santos FC	Brazil	Brazil national football team	footballer	Association football	forward	Forward (association football)	FC Barcelona	FC Barcelona	Brazil national team	Brazil national football team
Neymar came into prominence at an early age at Santos , where he made his professional debut aged 17 .	Santos	Santos FC

He helped the club win two successive Campeonato Paulista championships , a Copa do Brasil , and the 2011 Copa Libertadores , Santos ' first continental title since 1963 .	Santos	Santos FC	Campeonato Paulista	Campeonato Paulista	Copa do Brasil	Copa do Brasil	2011 Copa Libertadores	2011 Copa Libertadores	2011	2011 South American Footballer of the Year

Neymar was twice named the South American Footballer of the Year , in 2011 and 2012 , before relocating to Europe to join Barcelona .	Barcelona	FC Barcelona	South American Footballer of the Year	South American Footballer of the Year	2011	2011 South American Footballer of the Year	2012	2012 South American Footballer of the Year

As part of Barça 's attacking trio with Lionel Messi and Luis Suárez , he won the continental treble of La Liga , the Copa del Rey , and the UEFA Champions League in the 2014 -- 15 season , followed the next year by the domestic double . He came third for the FIFA Ballon d'Or in 2015 .	FIFA Ballon d'Or	FIFA Ballon d'Or	2015	2015 FIFA Ballon d'Or

With 52 goals in 77 matches for Brazil since debuting at age 18 , Neymar is the fourth-highest goalscorer for his national team .	Brazil	Brazil national football team	fourth-highest goalscorer	Brazil national football team#Top goalscorers

He was a key player in Brazil 's victories at the 2011 South American Youth Championship , which he finished as the leading goalscorer , and the 2013 FIFA Confederations Cup , where he won the Golden Ball as player of the tournament . His participation in the 2014 FIFA World Cup and 2015 Copa América was cut short by injury and a suspension respectively , but the next year he captained Brazil to their first Olympic gold medal in men 's football at the 2016 Summer Olympics .
